boundaries.name: poseidon-hash-opacity
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon `hash_inputs_u64` / `hash_no_pad` is an opaque callback; no collision resistance or injectivity is proved, and every binding statement is conditioned on an explicit premise about the two concrete compared preimages.

boundaries.name: keccak-opacity
boundaries.obligation: `solidity_keccak256` and the in-circuit `builder.keccak256` are opaque; only the 32-bit word preimage they are fed is modeled.

boundaries.name: native-target-refinement
boundaries.obligation: Native `to_u64_vec` and target `to_vec` are transcribed separately and only compared; that the compiled circuit lays out the same words is not proved.

boundaries.name: plonky2-range-check-lowering
boundaries.obligation: `builder.range_check(x, b)` is modeled as the predicate `x < 2 ^ b` on the canonical representative; the gate lowering that must implement it is not modeled.

boundaries.name: serde-bypasses-constructors
boundaries.obligation: Derived `Deserialize` on the private carriers (`U63(u64)`, `ChannelId(u32)`, `PoseidonHashOut`) can produce values that never passed `new`/`validate_components`; canonicality is a stated premise, never an invariant of the type.

boundaries.name: goldilocks-canonicality
boundaries.obligation: Word values are `Nat`s here; that a native `u64` word is a canonical Goldilocks element (and how `from_canonical_u64` behaves otherwise) is assumed only where stated.

boundaries.name: merkle-leafable-semantics
boundaries.obligation: `Leafable`/`LeafableTarget` tree membership, indexing and root semantics are out of scope; only the leaf preimage is modeled.

boundaries.name: caller-imposed-constraints
boundaries.obligation: Whether a nullifier, channel id or nonce is compared against the right set, and whether unchecked targets are range-checked by their callers, is decided outside these files and is not modeled.
